compute_summary: MDLM-OWT 130M, batch 1, lr 1e-4, 200 steps, institutional HPC 2x H100 NVL, 12 lanes total, wall time ~1.5 min for 27 cells.
mechanism_implication: Pre-equilibrium saturation is not preventable by column-orthonormality of LoRA-B. The direction-driven mechanism survives geometric constraints on the LoRA-B update space. Combined with K15n (init-amplitude), K15p (structure), K15o (init-direction PARTIAL), the saturation is structural across LoRA's degrees of freedom.
preregistered_threshold: WORKS: max-grad-norm ratio (top-decile / sub-median final loss) <=2.0x AND fire-rate <27/27. PARTIAL: ratio 2.0-2.5x. DOESN'T: ratio >=2.5x or fire 27/27.
schema: K15q Stiefel-manifold projection: after each optimizer step, replace each LoRA-B matrix with column-orthonormal basis from QR decomposition. Tests OPTIMIZER-GEOMETRY axis. MDLM-OWT 130M, r in {4,16,64} x rho in {0.05,0.40,0.90} x n=3 seeds = 27 cells, project every 1 step.
verdict_explanation: DOESN'T: fire 27/27 unchanged, fire-step median 11 identical to K15a baseline, step-0 top-1 identical (post-step projection has no effect at step 0). Paired max-grad ratio 0.97x (essentially identical) and final-loss delta +0.20 (slightly worse). Forcing column-orthonormality on LoRA-B every step does not prevent the direction-driven saturation. Rules out optimizer-geometry axis.
